recognition: nominal dependency evidence plus gerund form; never suffix alone; progressive and ambiguous parses do not authorize Nom
fixed_wsd: preserve verb synset; record nominalization as a construction, not a noun-sense replacement
source_budget: each nominalized verb and each attached not occurrence consumed at most once across ordinary calls and Nom
external_parameters: captured values remain free and unchanged; only declared formal role slots are abstracted
positive_template: NominalRef(h) AND forall roles (Holds(h,roles) IFF exists e FullVerbUsage(e,roles,captures))
negative_template: NominalRef(h) AND forall roles (Holds(h,roles) IFF Not(exists e FullVerbUsage(e,roles,captures)))
publication: symbolic enumeration and expansion do not certify a basis RHS or authorize publication
